model: Simplified 71-412, livery after Vladikavkaz car 485. Estimated dimensions 16.5 x 2.5 m.

sources.author: Rartat
sources.observed: Blue body, red lower insert, white roof, continuous dark glazing and red pantograph.
Wide front windscreen, twin vertical headlight clusters, tapering dark front mask, coupler; photographed vehicle 488.

usage: Original procedural Canvas drawing, no source pixels shipped. Front and side photos of different wagons of the same model inform a stylised representation, not a precise technical drawing.
route: Existing east track only. Kirova, Dzhanaeva, Teatralnaya square, then fades at model edge and starts the next pass. Gameplay timings, not a real service timetable. No real route number asserted.
